latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 90s Anime Art Generator.

- Generate 1990s anime-style and retro OVA illustrations with cel-shaded colors, hand-drawn line art, and analog film grain effects.
- Supports customizable image prompts, output size options (portrait, landscape, square, tall), and style inheritance via reference images.
- Uses the Neta AI image generation API (requires free trial token).
- Quick command-line usage with straightforward install instructions.
